movie.title: Lion
movie.overview: A five-year-old Indian boy gets lost on the streets of Calcutta, thousands of kilometers from home. He survives many challenges before being adopted by a couple in Australia; 25 years later, he sets out to find his lost family.

facts: Can you imagine? The movie 'Lion' kicks off with a truly heartbreaking scenario: a five-year-old Indian boy gets completely lost on the bustling streets of Calcutta, thousands of kilometers away from his home.
Before finding a new beginning, this brave little boy endures countless challenges. Eventually, he's adopted by a kind couple who live all the way across the globe in Australia!
Fast forward 25 years, and the story takes an incredible turn! The now-adult man decides to embark on an epic journey, determined to track down his long-lost biological family.
